name: Commission for the Arts
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Commission for the Arts
AGENDA
JUNE 1, 2015 -
05:00 PM
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
1.
CALL TO ORDER/ROLL CALL
2.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
3.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the Commission Secretary. If at least two Commissioners agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
4.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
5.
APPROVAL OF THE MINUTES OF THE APRIL 6, 2015 MEETING.
Approve the Minutes.
6.
ACTION ITEMS - OLD BUSINESS
6A.
Review Public Art Ad Hoc Committee Recommendations for MacKinnon Overpass. Contact Person: Commissioner Lueker.
Vote to approve recommendations.
7.
ACTION ITEMS - NEW BUSINESS
7A.
Discuss and Approve 2015/16 Work Plan. Contact Person: Chair Thum.
Vote to approve.
7B.
Proposed Visual Art Donation to the City by Carol Halverson. Contact Person: Arts Administrator Gilliam.
Vote on the donation.
8.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
8A.
Review the Arts Applications, Community Grant Program. Contact Person: Arts Administrator Gilliam.
8B.
Encinitas Friends of the Arts Report. Contact Person: Commissioner Tanha.
8C.
Pacific View Report: arts organization collaboration meeting, sculpture garden.
Contact Person: Arts Administrator Gilliam.
8D.
Public Art: Marine Safety Center. Contact Person: Commissioner Lueker.
8E.
Encinitas Student Film Festival. Contact Persons: Commissioners Filsinger and Stefanko.
8F.
iPalpiti Festival, July 9-18. Contact Person: Arts Administrator Gilliam.
8G.
Commission-sponsored and Co-sponsored Events:
Wednesdays@Noon concerts, June 3, 10, 17, 24, Encinitas Library
Music by the Sea concert, June 16, 7:30pm, Encinitas Library
Opening Reception: Donna Schichler, June 6, 1-4pm, Encinitas Library
9.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS
10.
COMMISSIONERS' REPORTS
11.
ARTS ADMINISTRATOR REPORTS
12.
ADJOURNMENT CERTIFICATION
I, Gina Zenns, Commission Secretary, City of Encinitas, California, hereby certify that the foregoing agenda was posted on the City of Encinitas website, www.encinitasca.gov, and on the City Hall outside bulletin board located at 505 South Vulcan Avenue, Encinitas, California, on May 13, 2015, 72 hours before this regular meeting.
